title: ces-tester demo deck — normalized sheet rows
description: Validates the rows produced by xlsx-loader.ts AFTER header normalization (lowercase, non-alphanumerics stripped, aliases mapped) and BEFORE grouping by slide number. Cell-level semantics that need a good message (tools membership, op id, image existence, unique-or-agree across a slide's rows) are checked in deck-validate.ts, not here.

sheetRow.description: 1-based spreadsheet row the founder sees in Excel; the header occupies row 1, so data starts at 2.

slide.description: slide # — required, integer >= 1. Rows sharing a value group onto one slide.

opmode.description: live | warm | staged; blank inherits from the slide's other rows.

durationsec.description: Per-slide dwell in seconds; blank falls back to --default-dwell.

html.description: Path, relative to the deck directory, to a self-contained .html document rendered in place of the auto-rendered body. Existence, the path fence, precedence over `image` and the inline-every-asset lint live in deck-validate.ts.

params.description: The op's declared parameters, `key=value` one per line (Alt+Enter in Excel). Keys, types, enum values and defaults are published in docs/demo/OP-CATALOG.md and enforced in deck-validate.ts against op-catalog.ts.

theme.description: Path, relative to the deck directory, to a theme JSON file ({ tokens: {...}, logo?: 'x.svg' }). DECK-LEVEL: it resolves unique-or-agree across the whole deck, and two slides naming different themes is an error. Token whitelist and value forms live in theme.ts.

show.description: RESERVED presenter column: stage directions. Captured per row and NOT rendered — reserved so a deck may carry it without an 'ignored unknown column' warning on every load.

watchouts.description: RESERVED presenter column: cautions for the presenter, per row. Rendered under the talk track only behind the --watchouts flag, which defaults OFF.

features.description: Major features for this row's function, one per line within the cell. Per-row, not per-slide: rows of one slide concatenate rather than conflict. Splitting, trimming and the display cap live in deck-validate.ts. Typed inline rather than via $ref because draft-07 ignores keywords sitting beside a $ref.
